column1: # Rotation corrections for JLCPCB pick-and-place files.
# JLCPCB's part library does not always use KiCad's zero-rotation orientation.
# Each row adds "rotation" degrees (and an offset in mm) to every placement
# whose footprint name matches the regular expression. First match wins.
# Rows below are copied from the Fabrication-Toolkit project (Apache-2.0)
# They have NOT been checked against JLCPCB's placement preview for the parts
# in this repository. Check the preview when ordering and correct this file.
